en: I ain't gonna forgive you, pretty boy!
Hey. That's enough.
What, you want a taste of this, too?

I'm not sure what's going on here, but three
of you versus one of him? Doesn't seem fair.

Nobody asked for your opinion, gramps!
We're gonna make you pay for messing with us!
What... What the hell <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> you!?

Y-You totally saved my skin...
Thank you so much.

Um, I'm Junta Takayama. I don't mean to pry,
but could you tell me your name?

Kiryu-san it is, then. Um, if it's all right with
you, could I repay you for this somehow?

I was just helping a civilian in need.
No need to thank me.
Come on, let me do <font_kind=yakuza_italic>something</font_kind>.

That's it! You know the bar Bantam, right?
I spend most of my time drinking over there.

If you're ever free, I'd like to at least
buy you a round of drinks to say thanks.

All right, then.
I'll stop by if I'm feeling thirsty.

Yes, please do. 
Well, I'll be going now.

Oh, Kiryu-san!
I'm so glad you came!

I have to say, I really had my back to the wall
when you showed up. Thank you so much.

The truth is, I'm an actor. I can't exactly
raise a fist to my potential audience.

Understandable. Life is pretty rough
in the entertainment industry.

But I have to wonder, what were
those guys so upset with you about?

Well... They're fans of a famous
idol who goes by the name Yuka-chan.

In a recent episode, I kabedon'd Yuka-chan
real good. I guess they were upset about that.

Yes. Drama aficionados have actually
started calling me the Kabedon Prince.

Huh...
Sorry, but I don't follow TV too closely.
So... What exactly is kabedon?

Wait, you don't know?
It's really taken off lately.
I'm pretty sure I've eaten a kabedon before.
Oh, you're probably talking about katsudon.
It's the mythological guy with the trident, right?
Are you sure you don't mean Poseidon?

Is that where you hit the wall
to make your neighbors quiet down?

You're not technically wrong... but the kind
I'm talking about is not quite the same.

Kabedon is, well...
You know, it might be quicker to just show you.

Kiryu-san, please stand
in front of the wall over there.
Here?
Yes, that's perfect.
Now then, here I come.

Hold on a second!
What are you doing!?

Well?
This is the magic of kabedon.

From here, a girl's ear is only a breath away.
The intimacy alone will set her heart on fire.
I'm not sure I get it...

Stop that!
Get your mouth away from my ear!

My perfect kabedon has driven girls crazy for years.
That's how I became the Kabedon Prince.
I can't believe people are really into that...

It can be quite a thrill.
Maybe you should take it for a spin, Kiryu-san.

A refined guy like you mastering the kabedon?
Man, you'd have girls drooling all over you.
Me? Uh, I don't know about this.

It'll be second nature once you get some practice.
You'll just need to dive into it headfirst.
How about... Ah, Kamaishi-san!
Oho? You rang?

This is Kamaishi-san. She's one of my
more frequent drinking buddies.

And this here is Kiryu-san, a new pupil in the art
of kabedon. Do you mind if he practices on you?

Ohhh, what a fine piece of man!
I'm honored to have been chosen as your first!
'Kay! Come at me!

The process is simple. Just walk up to Kamaishi-san,
then place your hand on the wall behind her.
G-Got it.
Okay, here goes nothing.

I'm ready, Kiryu-san!
Come on!
Cool it with the noises!

Kiryu-san! Next you whisper something sexy
in her ear to ignite the flame in her heart!
Give me all your money.

Oooh, I'll hand over however much you want.
Use it wisely, muscle man!

Kiryu-san, that was nothing short of a mugging,
and don't give in so easily, Kamaishi-san!
Why would you think to say something like that?

Don't women have a thing for dangerous guys?
I was just trying to spice things up.

That makes sense, but you were giving off a total
shakedown vibe. No girl would ever fall for that.
Kamaishi... You're not going home tonight.

Ahhh! Hearing that from a big, burly man
like yourself... I'm so excited!
Well? How was that?

Nice work there! You pinned her down with
the kabedon, then finished her off with a line!

Kiryu-san! Where are you taking me tonight?
Anywhere you want, hot stuff!

Slow down there.
I was just practicing.

Well, ain't that a bummer.
I'm ready whenever you want me, though.
U-Uh huh...
Tonight... You're mine, Kamaishi.
Ohhh, I can't wait! A night with this hottie?
I'm getting all tingly just thinking about it!

You're taking this way too far!
Calm down!

You're... not bad. It's been ages
since someone got me this hot.

Not bad, Kiryu-san. For your first kabedon,
that was actually pretty impressive.

It's tougher than it looks.
I'm surprised you make it seem so simple.

I'm glad you found your calling.
You're practically a kabedon master.

Well, maybe so. That said,
it's not always a positive part of my life.

Sometimes I get made fun of on the street
or have to deal with people stalking me.

It's almost impossible to find private time.
That's why I come here. It's my safe haven.
By the way, I had a great time today!
Oh, shoot! I've got to be getting to work.

I really appreciate all the help, Kiryu-san.
Let me at least cover your tab. Well, until next time!
Right. Good luck with your work.

Thanks!
Now then, I'm off!
Hey, we got our asses beat real bad 'cause of you.

I've got some pros helping me now, though.
We're gonna make sure you never kabedon again!

Hey, how 'bout giving me one last kabedon first?
Sound good?

I refuse. None of you are worthy
of my prized kabedon.
The fuck you say!?

If it's a kabedon you want so bad,
I'm happy to oblige.
Wait! You're the guy from before...!
Stay back, Takayama.

I'm gettin' real sick of you, buddy...
You're going down this time!

Now where were we...?
Still hoping for that kabedon?
N-No, I...

You don't have a choice. You're going to
taste the full force of Takayama's kabedon.
P-Please don't!

Resisting is going to get you hurt.
Let's do this!
Give me all your money...!

A-All right!
Just please don't kill me!
H-Hey, wait up!
You're not going home tonight...!
You're mine, punk...!

I-I-I'll give you every last yen I've got!
Please just let me live!
You okay, Takayama?

Y-Yeah...
Rescued by you yet again, Kiryu-san...
And? How was my kabedon?
It was incredible.

Compared to yours, mine is nothing.
Kiryu-san, your kabedon even works on guys.

If I'm the Kabedon Prince...
you very well may be the Kabedon King.
The Kabedon King...

Well, I really should be going now.
Thank you for everything!

The Kabedon King... Heh.
It's got a nice ring to it.

This isn't a number I recognize.
Who could it be...?

Ah, hi there!
It's me!
Hm... Me?
Yup. You know who I am.

(I wonder who this guy is...
Wait, I think I recognize his voice.)
(Could it be... Daigo?)
(No. Daigo's young, but he's not <font_kind=yakuza_italic>this</font_kind> young.)
(It couldn't be Haruto, could it...?)

(No, Haruto's too young to stand up
on his own, let alone talk on the phone.)
Is that you... Taichi?
Yeah! It's me, Taichi!

I could barely tell. Do you have a cold
or something? You sound kinda weird.

Yeah, this sore throat is doing a
number on my voice!

Well, that's no good.
Make sure you get some rest.

I will. By the way, are you good to talk?
Where are you right now?
Hm? Oh, I'm in Kamurocho.
Got it. Kamurocho, then.

Um... I know this is kinda out of the blue,
but I have something I need to ask.

Well, one of my friends got hurt
real bad, and it's totally my fault.

They're asking me to cover both
the treatment and his hospital bills.
I don't have that kind of money, though...

So, um... I was wondering if you'd
be able to spot me a bit of cash.

If you can't, I'll probably end up
saddled with debt for years to come.
(Taichi is really in trouble here...)
(Wait a second...)

(I feel like I've heard about scams
that sound a little like this.)
(I should figure out what's going on here.)

Taichi, where are you calling me from?
I don't recognize this number.

Oh, I got a new phone.
A new number, too.

Wait, have you ever even owned a phone?
That's news to me.
Huh? Oh, s-sorry.

Guess I just forgot to tell you.
I actually bought one a little while ago.

(This is no time to be distrustful.
Taichi needs my help here.)

Okay, then.
How much do you need?
They said around 200,000...
200 grand!?

Oh, but if that's too much for you,
I'll take whatever you can get your hands on.

I should be able to scrounge
together the rest myself.
A-All right...

I have to wonder, though...
How did you hurt your friend so badly?
Well, uh... We got in a terrible accident.

What? You mean, like a car accident?
You don't even have a driver's license.

Oh, uh... That's not it at all!
It was, um... more like a freak accident.

(What is that even supposed to mean?
I wonder...)
Have you been wrestling again?

Uh, yeah! My friend and I were
pretending we were pros...
Taichi, I don't want to treat you like a kid.

But that means you need to stop behaving
like one. Try to act your age, okay?

And your friend?
How's he doing?

W-Well, the doctor said he'll be totally
fine as long as he gets into surgery soon.
So, his surgery is the top priority.

How do you want me to send the money?
I can't come back to Okinawa right now.
Huh? Okinawa?

Aren't you still at Morning Glory?
Don't tell me... Did you leave Okinawa, too?

U-Uh, oh! Th-That's right! As is the
customary greeting in Okinawa, "mensore"!

(Why would he give me an Okinawan welcome?
I wonder why he's acting so strange...)

(With everything that's happened,
he's probably just looking for a distraction.)

Taichi. I know things are rough right now,
but times like this are what make a man.

Yeah... You're right.
I've gotta get a grip here.
(I should try to help get his mind off it.)
Ah, mensore!
Wh-What? What's all that about?
...Huh?

Anyway, I'm kinda in a hurry here.
Can we get back to the point?
I'm down in Okinawa right now.

My hurt buddy's dad is apparently
in Tokyo on business, though.
I'm gonna need you to give him the cash.

I'll tell him to wait over by
the Millennium Tower for you.

You think you'll be able to scrape up
the money and head over there now?
...Yeah, I can do that.

Great! His dad's name is Ishigaki-san,
just so you know. Well, thanks again!

All right then, off to the Millennium Tower.
Ishigaki-san's waiting for me.
(This must be someone trying to scam me.)

(I can't believe they'd really steal from
a random stranger over the phone.)

(I should play along and show him what
happens to people who pull stunts like this.)
All right. What do you need me to do?

Oh, I actually just heard my friend's dad
is up in Kamurocho right now.

Do, um... Do you think you could
give him the money for me?
Wow. That's a pretty amazing coincidence.

Isn't it? His dad's name is Ishigaki-san, by the way.
I'll tell him to wait over by the Millennium Tower.
Please, can you bring him the money?

Really!? Great!
Well, thanks again!

All right then, off to the Millennium Tower.
I'm coming for you, you thieving bastard.

(Is this the father of the kid Taichi hurt?
I'm pretty sure his name is Ishigaki.)
So, are you Ishigaki-san?

Ah, yes. I'm Akira Ishigaki.
And you are?

Oh, so you're the guy.
Taichi-kun told me everything.

I'm sorry he's put your family
through so much trouble.

It's okay. For now, I just want to get
back to my son as soon as possible!

Is it all right if you cover
the treatment fees, Kiryu-san?

I don't want to put Taichi-kun in debt,
but he'll need to pay for it if you can't help.

(I need to make sure they have enough
to cover their son's hospital bills.)

(More importantly, I can't let
Taichi end up in debt!)

I'm sorry about this. I didn't have much
time, so I couldn't get the full amount.

I see... Okay, then. For now, I'll gladly
take whatever you have to offer.

Here you are, 200 grand.
Please use this to save your son.

Thank you so much.
You're a good man.

Well then, it's about time I head
back to Okinawa to help my son!

Once he's out of surgery, I'll have
Taichi-kun get in touch with you.
I hope his son recovers soon.

I should let Taichi know I gave him the money.
The number he called me from earlier should work.
Hm? Damn, voicemail...
Oh well. I'll just call Morning Glory instead.

Hello, Ayako? Is Taichi there?
Yeah, I need to talk to him for a bit.

Taichi? I just gave Ishigaki-san the money.
You don't need to worry.
